about: Why a conversation failed, read from what the person said when they pushed back (and, for refusals, the reply they were reacting to). Ordered: the first matching rule wins. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions; {B} is a word boundary, {AP} an optional apostrophe. Shared by site/try/engine.js and scripts/failure_reasons.py so the try page and the dashboard agree. For a repeated request, a rule counts only if its words are new: matched in the repeat but not in the request it repeats, so the original task ('translate this', 'in 150 words') is not mistaken for a complaint. Short repeats (40 characters or fewer, such as 'continue') are pushback in themselves and are read in full.

reasons.label: Refused or dodged
reasons.plain: The assistant declined or deflected, and the person pushed back.
reasons.fix: Review refusal rules and system prompt for over-cautious declines.
reply: ^\s*(?:i{AP}m sorry|i am sorry|sorry,? (?:but )?i{B}|i (?:cannot|can{AP}t|can not) (?:help|assist|provide|do|comply|fulfill|fulfil|generate|create|write|continue|share|give){B}|i{AP}m unable|i am unable|as an ai{B}|i{AP}m not able|i am not able|unfortunately,? i (?:cannot|can{AP}t)|很抱歉|对不起|抱歉|извините|к сожалению,? я не могу)

reasons.label: Didn't work
reasons.plain: The person tried the answer and it failed: an error, a crash, the same problem.
reasons.fix: Replay these cases as tests; check the code or steps actually run.
feedback: 报错|还是不行|运行不了|无法运行|不能用|没用|错误提示|不起作用|не работает|ошибка:|выдает ошибку|все ещ[её]|no funciona|sigue (?:sin|igual|fallando)

reasons.label: Incomplete or cut off
reasons.plain: The answer stopped early or left parts out.
reasons.fix: Raise output limits or ask for the full answer in one reply.
feedback: 继续|没写完|不完整|还没完|写完|продолж|допиши|не закончил|continúa|sigue{B}

reasons.label: Ignored instructions
reasons.plain: The person had already said what they wanted, and the answer didn't follow it.
reasons.fix: Check instruction-following: system prompt, context length, conflicting rules.
feedback: (?:i (?:told|asked) you|as i (?:said|asked)|i already (?:said|told|asked)|i said (?:to|not)|follow (?:the|my) instructions?|you ignored|did ?n{AP}t (?:follow|listen|read)|read (?:it |my message )?again|re-?read)
我说了|我让你|我已经说|按照我的要求|я же сказал|я просил|я же просил|ya te dije

reasons.label: Wrong language
reasons.plain: The answer came back in the wrong language.
reasons.fix: Detect the user's language and answer in it by default.
feedback: 用中文|用英文|中文回答|说中文|翻译成|по-русски|на русском|en español

reasons.label: Wrong length or format
reasons.plain: Right idea, wrong shape: too long, too short, or not the format asked for.
reasons.fix: Set length and format expectations in the system prompt; offer a format control.
feedback: {B}(?:too (?:long|short|wordy|brief|much|detailed)|shorter|longer|more concise|less (?:words|text)|more (?:words|detail)|in \d+ (?:words|sentences|lines|bullet)|word count|bullet(?: point)?s|as a (?:table|list)|in a table|in (?:the|this|that) format|one (?:sentence|paragraph|line)){B}
太长|太短|简短一点|字数|分点|表格|короче|длиннее|más corto|más largo

reasons.label: Misunderstood the request
reasons.plain: The answer addressed a different question from the one asked.
reasons.fix: Ask a clarifying question when a request is ambiguous; add examples of the task.
feedback: (?:not what i (?:asked|meant|wanted|need)|that{AP}s not (?:it|what)|i meant{B}|i mean{B}|i (?:was )?asking (?:for|about)|i wanted{B}|i need(?:ed)? (?:you to|a|the)|you misunderstood|misunderstood|did ?n{AP}t understand|not asking|^\s*no,? i)
我是说|我的意思|不是这个意思|不是我要的|不是我说的|я имел в виду|не то{B}|не так{B}|no es eso|eso no{B}|ce n{AP}est pas

reasons.label: Factually wrong
reasons.plain: The answer stated something false or got a detail wrong.
reasons.fix: Ground answers in sources or tools; add these cases as factual tests.

fallback.label: Sent the same request again
fallback.plain: The person asked exactly the same thing again, like pressing regenerate: the answer didn't satisfy them, and they didn't say why.
fallback.fix: Compare the first and second answers in a few examples; the gap is usually depth, accuracy or tone.

fallback.label: Reworded the request
fallback.plain: The person asked again in different words, as if trying to be understood.
fallback.fix: Treat as a missed intent: add these rewordings as test cases and check the first answer's reading of the request.

fallback.label: Pushed back, reason unclear
fallback.plain: The person corrected the answer, but in words these rules don't recognise.
fallback.fix: Read a few examples to find the pattern.
